requirements.description: User prefers properties near green spaces. Value set to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct surface threshold. The 45-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Energy class and proximity to green spaces are not reference columns and are not extracted.

The user prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through D. Area, capacity, location and green-space preferences are outside the energy scope and were not translated into requirements.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 600 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 74 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Applies the four extracted requirements: surface_area >= 600; energy_class in A1-A4, B, C, D; green >= 74; and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by distance from that point, nearest first. No property-type, capacity, or other filters were added because they were not in the extracted requirements.
